themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, particularly in response to border crises. This includes proposals to ban foreign nationals from welfare systems, stricter border controls, and reactions to migrant surges in border cities like Ceuta and Melilla.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposed banning foreign nationals from welfare benefits, citing cost savings and potential retaliation risks.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticized Spain's government for abandoning Ceuta and Melilla, proposing sovereignty swaps with Morocco.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Condemned migrant boat incidents and called for stricter immigration controls in Sardinia.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Opposed irregular migration and advocated for stricter border policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocated for stricter immigration policies and accountability in migrant-related incidents.
